name: Ethereum
notes: ELPIDA V2.3 launchpad on Ethereum (prepared 24 November 2026): every fee split 50% traders (monthly EWPR airdrop in USDC) / 30% creator / 20% treasury; no flywheel or holder-reward vault. Ethereum starts on V2.3 directly. Same treasury Safe, keeper and guardian as Base, BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain. treasury: the Elpida Treasury Safe (same address, owners and 2-of-3 threshold as on Base; add this network to it in the Safe app before `check`); keeper and guardian: the same wallets as Base (18 Nov 2026). dailyLaunchCap 1000 and minFeeBps 100 follow Malik's Base decision. PoolManager: Uniswap's v4 deployment on Ethereum (developers.uniswap.org v4 deployments). usdFeed: Chainlink ETH / USD (1 h heartbeat, so feedMaxAge 3 h); `check` confirms its description and freshness and that USDC has 6 decimals. Gas: the launchpad is about 12.5M gas and the USDC distributor about 2M more, so deployGas is 15M; `check` asks for 15M × (base fee + 25% + tip) at that moment, never less than 0.003 ETH. Deploy on a low-gas day. explorerApi: Blockscout, only to find an existing stock holder to impersonate on a fork (`rehearse --fork <rpc> --stocks config/stocks/candidates/ethereum-ondo.json`).
